The '''Drayvos League''' was a political organization active during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. In [[3637 BBY]], [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was serving as an emissary to the League.<ref name="Forged">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Republic|Forged Alliances, Part I|Carrick Station}}</ref>
